title: The ARC Principle and Eden Protocol: Recursive Intelligence Scaling and Embedded AI Alignment
description: An open research programme (18 documents + code + data) on recursive capability and alignment scaling. Headline, defensible findings: (1) under a four-layer blind evaluation protocol, the measured alignment-vs-reasoning-depth effect reversed sign for two frontier model families (DeepSeek, Gemini) versus unblinded scoring — i.e. unblinded LLM-as-judge evaluation can be directionally wrong; (2) a stakeholder-care ("Stewardship Gene") intervention — having a model identify who is affected and how before answering — improved measured ethical reasoning across five models (Fisher-combined p ≈ 6.3×10⁻²¹). The four-layer/double-blinding methodology and the cross-domain Cauchy unification are the author's original contributions. The sequential-vs-parallel recursion result is independently corroborated by Sharma & Chopra (arXiv:2511.02309, 2025) and no priority is claimed for it; the bare d/(d+1) scaling exponent is acknowledged prior art. The programme is presented with explicit limitations and falsification criteria and invites independent replication. The author does not claim to have solved AI alignment.
notes: Companion repository: arc-scaling-challenge (open falsification toolkit). Canonical book: Infinite Architects: Intelligence, Recursion, and the Creation of Everything (2026, ISBN 1806056208).
